name: Critical Thinking Errors
excerpt: Critical thinking errors include entitlement, SUDs, and rationalization.
notes: Critical thinking errors such as entitlement, seemingly unimportant decisions (SUDs), and rationalization can lead to unethical behavior. These errors highlight the importance of maintaining ethical standards and awareness.
